newsitem.title: USA: U.S. makes big cocaine haul off Honduras.
newsitem.headline: U.S. makes big cocaine haul off Honduras.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard said on Wednesday it had seized almost 4,300 pounds (1,955 kg) of cocaine off the coast of Honduras, its largest haul this year.
The Coast Guard said one of its helicopters sighted the 40-foot (13-metre) motorboat, known as a "go-fast" boat, 16 miles east of Honduras on Tuesday.
As it chased the vessel, the smugglers dumped the cargo of narcotics, headed back toward Honduran waters and escaped.
A Coast Guard cutter arrived on the scene shortly afterward and recovered 71 bales of cocaine.

The U.S. Customs office in Miami said the wholesale value of the haul in south Florida would be more than $33 million. The street value could be at least 10 times that, depending on how the cocaine was processed.
